meta.question: Q-01: the user asked to rank hotels by Michelin restaurants within 1 hour by subway or bus.
meta.answer: Las Vegas has no subway or metro rail. The 'by subway or bus' constraint is therefore modelled on three systems that do not share a ticket: RTC transit buses (The Deuce / SDX / local routes), the Las Vegas Monorail, and the Boring Company Vegas Loop.
meta.honesty: Every minute figure here is an ESTIMATE built from official station lists and route maps, rounded to 5 minutes. No official source publishes door-to-door travel times. These are planning estimates, not timetables.
meta.generated_by: scripts/build.py recomputes michelin_within_60 and michelin_within_20 in data/hotels.json from this matrix — do not hand-edit those two fields.

systems.name: Las Vegas Monorail
systems.note: 3.9 miles end to end, roughly 4–8 minute headways. Does NOT reach the airport or downtown.

systems.name: RTC Transit — The Deuce & SDX
systems.fare_note: Strip & Downtown Express / Deuce: $4 single, $6 2-hour, $8 24-hour, $20 3-day. Nevada local fares are $1.
systems.note: The only 24-hour option, and the only one that reaches downtown (Fremont Street) and the Arts District.

systems.name: Vegas Loop (Boring Company)
systems.fare_note: Encore / Resorts World / Westgate $4.75 (day pass $13.25); Las Vegas Convention Center ↔ Strip $5; Fontainebleau $7.00; SAHARA $7.50; airport $12–14.
systems.note: Point-to-point in Tesla vehicles, not a rail line. Fare bands vary by station pair.

finding.inside_60: The Strip is about 4 miles long and Chinatown is about 3 miles west of it, so EVERY hotel in the dataset — including Henderson and Summerlin — reaches all 24 Michelin listings inside 60 minutes. The user's literal metric returns a flat 24/24 for every property and therefore cannot rank anything.
finding.fix: A second, stricter column was added: how many Michelin restaurants are within a 20-MINUTE one-way trip. That column separates the field and drives the ranking.
finding.disclose: This substitution is a material interpretation of the brief and is raised as Q-01 on the Questions page.
